vb_textbox.text: To be able to play effectively and earn more mushroom, you have to note the following keys S, K and the space key. your left hand should be the S key and your right hand on the K plus you should also focus on the space key. You will see two houses you have to press pick one of the houses by pressing the S key or the Y key after which it takes you to a farm with a basket. The trick is you have to be very fast in clicking the S or K and the the space key when it takes you to the farm so you can gain the mushroom as your price. The second treak is you have to be consistent with the keys. If key K gives you high musroom then you have to keep clicking on it till it gives you lower mushroom ten you can switch keys.
